text.p: The following are the reports carried by Estonia's newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- Mayor of Tallinn Robert Lepikson has not stopped his Coalition Party membership as has been claimed in the media, Prime Minister Mart Siimann said.

- Estonian-Russian cultural relations remain good, Culture Minister Jaak Allik said. The Russian culture minister will arrive for a visit to Tallinn tomorrow and Estonian cultural days will begin in Moscow on March 28.
- The first heart patient in Estonia had a pace-maker implanted in his heart at an operation in a Tartu hospital, doctors said.
- New Agriculture Minister Andres Varik says in an interview he will improve cooperation and the exchange of information with parliament in order to promote rural life.
- The sixth motor show Motorex is open on March 19-21 at the Eesti Naitused exhibition grounds in Tallinn. 135 firms from 11 countries are represented, the organisers said.
- More attention should be paid on professional training, new Education Minister Mait Klaassen stresses in an interview.
- Pop star Michael Jackson will give a concert in Tallinn on August 22.

- United States and Russia will not be bargaining over the future of the Baltic states at the Helsinki summit, although the media have spread such fears, Estonian Foreign Minister Toomas Hendrik Ilves says in an interview.
- 47,840 shares of gas company Eesti Gaas will be sold for privatisation vouchers in June, the privatisation agency council decided.
